d: Nick's assignment to find squares becomes a fun shape spotting adventure as Barney and the kids search the park for geometric shapes.
The children explore how cars and buses work while Barney teaches lessons about vehicle safety transportation and travel.
Barney teaches the children how to recognize express and cope with angry feelings in healthy positive and safe ways.
It is Barney's birthday and the children celebrate with songs games surprises and lots of love to make the day extra special.
Barney BJ and the children prepare songs dances and skits learning practice teamwork and creativity for a special park performance.
Working together the children build a birdhouse and learn about nature animal homes and how different creatures live in the park.
Barney helps the kids understand feelings like happy sad and angry and shows them healthy ways to express and talk about emotions.
A class project becomes a chance for Barney and the children to talk about love family friendship and meaningful relationships.
A fun music-filled day helps the children explore rhythm beat instruments and creative expression through play and listening.
Barney leads the children in new dances races and dramatic play encouraging creativity movement and imaginative exploration.
Using their imaginations the children design and build a pretend airplane learning about invention teamwork and make-believe.
A picture sparks Barney and the children to imagine exploring a tropical island filled with pretend adventures and discoveries.
